ModMetaData.description:
Wake-Up reduces selected repeated loading work and keeps independent improvements available alongside other loaders. Prepatcher is required; companion mods are optional. This corrected 0.4.0 release has bounded Windows evidence, including startup with YaOpt, Image Opt and Adaptive Storage Framework. Linux/Steam Deck remains outside the tested scope.
Settings show which requested operations are available, who supplies them and why an operation cannot run. A single compatibility window explains new conflicts. Acknowledgement preserves your choices; Wake-Up never changes another mod's settings or removes its patches. Unknown changed code falls back at the affected operation. Restart after settings changes.
Default search improvements and exact optional integrations can coexist with supplier-owned loading. Additional controls include native PNG/JPEG output reuse, explicit texture preparation/quality, translations, resource lookup, loading display/reports and loading-only background behavior. Optional caches and display controls are not an all-options performance preset. Building a cache costs time and disk space; warm results depend on the selected content.
RimThemes keeps its custom loader when enabled. No Modlist on Loading keeps its DLC panel unless you explicitly choose to hide the whole summary. Loading Progress keeps its screen and repaint improvement; supported background cooperation requires its deferred renderer repaint option to be off. FastLoader keeps its raw texture cache; its atlas ownership prevents competing prepared-quality replacement. See the included source documentation for exact versions, settings and evidence limits.
Independent parsed XML, inheritance caching, ordered read-ahead, parsed-language persistence, authored-DDS recaching, managed first-build acceleration, static atlas caching and atlas batching remain retired. Streaming XML is experimental. On-demand assets, progressive detail and companion applications remain deferred. Wake-Up does not replace complete supplier suites.
The optional Windows helper supports explicit quality conversion and DDS exports. These choices can change pixels and dimensions; original artwork stays intact. Native PNG/JPEG reuse needs no helper. Do not enable alongside another Wake-Up or validation copy.
